blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Agentic Robotics, in which foundation models act as coding agents to control robots through executable programs, has emerged as a compelling paradigm for embodied intelligence. Yet unlike software engineering, where massive executable environments power post-training, robotics remains constrained by small, manual benchmarks and in-distribution evaluation. To bridge this gap, we introduce RoboUniverse-10K, 10,807 interactive, resettable, and verifiable physics environments built from real-world videos via an automated Real2Sim and quality assurance pipeline. Each runs in an isolated, Harbor-compatible harness that hides privileged states and grading logic to mirror real-world sensing. From the same pipeline, we hold out 500 unseen tasks to establish RoboUniverse-Verified, an expert-verified zero-shot benchmark. Evaluating 11 closed- and open-source models reveals a huge gap: frontier models reach 85.8\% success, while open-source baselines lag at 2.6\% to 10.0\%, bottlenecked by low-level grasping, deformable-object manipulation, and post-contact physical control. Finally, we collect about 17K multi-turn trajectories totaling 0.79B tokens with GPT-6 Astra and perform full-parameter supervised fine-tuning on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, yielding RoboUniverse-35B-A3B. Our model achieves substantial zero-shot gains on RoboUniverse-Verified, lifting the success rate from 0.8\% to 21.2\%, while achieving zero-shot task completions across LIBERO-MAX, RoboCasa, RoboTwin 2.0, and a real Franka arm. We open-source the RL-ready environments and model to lay the foundation for large-scale reinforcement learning in Agentic Robotics.
blocks.zh: 代理机器人(Agentic Robotics),其中基础模型起到编码代理作用,通过可执行程序控制机器人,它已成为体现智能的令人信服的范式. 然而,与软件工程不同的是,在软件工程中,大规模可执行环境在培训后提供动力,机器人仍然受到小型手工基准和分配评价的限制。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了RoboUniverse-10K,10,807交互,可重置,可核查的物理环境,这些环境是通过一个自动化的Real2Sim和质量保证管道从现实世界视频中构建的. 每个都运行在一个孤立的,与港湾兼容的拉带中,隐藏特权状态和分级逻辑来映射真实世界的感知. 在同一条管道中,我们承担着500项不可见的任务,以建立 " Robo Universe-Veriferated " ,一个经过专家验证的零射线基准。 评估11个封闭式和开源式模型揭示了一个巨大的差距:前沿模型达到85.8\%成功,而开源基线则滞后于2.6\%到10.0\%,被低水平的抓取,变形-对象操纵,以及接触后物理控制所瓶颈. 最后,我们收集了约17K个多转轨距,共含GPT-6 Astra的0.79B令牌,并在Qune3.6-35B-A3B上执行全参数监督微调,产生RoboUniverse-35B-A3B. 我们的模式在RoboUniverse-Veriferized上取得了实质性的零射得分,成功率从0.8×××提高到21.2××××××××,同时在LIBERO-MAX,RoboCasa,RoboTwin2.0上实现了零射任务完成,还有真正的Franka臂. 我们开放了RL准备环境和模式,为在Agentic Robotics进行大规模强化学习奠定基础.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recently, Agentic Robotics —a paradigm in which frontier foundation models act as Coding Agents to control robots—has emerged rapidly. Rather than relying solely on end-to-end visuomotor mappings, these agents write and execute code that invokes perception tools, planning routines, and low-level control interfaces in a closed-loop manner [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] , already surpassing end-to-end Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies on several mainstream leaderboards [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] . Looking to the trajectory of software engineering (SWE), the rapid capability leap of coding agents has been fundamentally driven by large-scale, executable, and automatically verifiable post-training environments [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 ] . By mining real-world pull requests to construct hundreds of thousands of interactive repositories, the SWE community unlocked large-scale trajectory distillation and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] , yielding substantial gains for open-source models on benchmarks such as SWE-bench [ 20 ] . We posit that the cornerstone of general-purpose Embodied Intelligence is generalization, and the root of generalization lies in the scale and diversity of training environments.
blocks.zh: 最近,代理机器人学——前沿基础模型作为控制机器人的编码代理人——迅速出现。 这些代理商不只依赖端到端的粘贴机映射,而是以闭路方式编写和执行引用感知工具的代码,规划常规,以及低级控制界面[1,2,3,4,5,6],在几个主流领导板上已经超过了端到端的视觉-语言-行动(VLA)政策[7,8,9]. 从软件工程(SWE)的轨迹来看,编码剂的快速能力飞跃从根本上是由大规模,可执行,可自动核查的训练后环境[10,11,12,13,14,15,16]驱动的. 通过开采真实世界的拉动请求建造数十万个交互式储存库,瑞典妇女教育协会解锁了大规模轨迹蒸馏和强化学习,并具有可核查的奖励(RLVR)[17、18、19],为SWE-bench [20]等基准的开放源模型带来了巨大收益。 我们认为,通用智能的基石是通用化,通用化的根源在于培训环境的规模和多样性。

blocks.en: Yet Agentic Robotics has not truly entered its scaling era, primarily due to two fundamental bottlenecks. First, the bottleneck of environment scale and construction cost. Existing robotic simulation benchmarks—such as LIBERO, RoboCasa, RoboTwin, and RoboDojo [ 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 , 25 ] —rely heavily on manual scene authoring and handcrafted success criteria, keeping their task counts limited to tens or a few hundred. Even recent efforts that leverage LLMs or real-world videos to synthesize simulation tasks (e.g., Real2Gym and Gym-Anything for Robotics) [ 26 , 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 , 31 , 32 , 33 ] remain modest in scale. Unlike software engineering tasks that can be mined directly from existing code repositories, each robotic task requires constructing a physically plausible interactive scene and authoring rigorous verification logic, incurring a far higher construction cost. Second, the lack of generalization caused by “train on test.” Constrained by limited environment scale, prior works [ 34 , 35 , 36 , 37 ] typically train and evaluate agents within the same task settings and environment distributions. Training and testing in homogeneous environments not only risks overfitting, but also fails to faithfully demonstrate an agent’s true generalization to unseen physical scenes and novel manipulation tasks.
blocks.zh: 然而,主要由于两个根本性的瓶颈,代理机器人还没有真正进入其规模化时代。 第一,环境规模和建筑成本的瓶颈。 现有的机器人模拟基准——例如LIBERO、RoboCasa、RoboTwin和RoboDojo[21、22、23、24、25]——大量采用人工现场编剧和手工制作的成功标准,使其任务数限制在几十或几百。 即使是最近利用LLMS或现实世界视频合成模拟任务(如Real2Gym和Gym-Anything for Robotics)[26,27,28,29,30,31,32,33]的努力,规模仍然不大. 与可以直接从现有代码寄存器中挖掘出来的软件工程任务不同,每个机器人任务都需要构建一个物理上可行的交互场景,并编写严格的核查逻辑,从而产生远为更高的建筑成本. 第二,“试验训练”造成缺乏普遍性。 由于环境尺度有限,以往的工程[34、35、36、37]通常在相同的任务环境和环境分布范围内训练和评价代理人。 在同质环境下的训练和试验不仅有过于适应的风险,而且没有忠实地表明一个代理人对看不见的物理场景和新的操纵任务的真正概括。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we introduce RoboUniverse-10K , a suite of 10,807 interactive, resettable, and automatically verifiable Isaac Sim [ 38 ] environments across 4,132 single-arm Franka and 6,675 dual-arm AgileX tasks for Agentic Robotics post-training and evaluation. Inspired by mining SWE tasks from real-world pull requests, we convert diverse real-world robot manipulation videos into distinct concrete tasks via hierarchical deduplication and normalization. Specifically, an end-to-end Real2Sim construction and quality assurance (QA) pipeline equips a coding agent with SAM 3.1 [ 39 ] , DA3 [ 40 ] , a curated asset library, and physics-modeling skills to reconstruct scenes, author reference solutions, and write verifiers, which an independent QA agent audits for physical fidelity, reset consistency, and verifier robustness against reward hacking. Meanwhile, a Harbor-compatible isolated harness separates the code-execution sandbox from the simulator and verifier, restricting interaction to public observations and control APIs while hiding ground-truth states and grading logic to mirror real-world constraints and support parallel rollouts.
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了RoboUniverse-10K,一套10,807个互动、可重置和自动可核查的Isaac Sim[38]环境,覆盖4,132个单臂Franka和6,675个双臂Agile。 X任务 代理机器人 后培训和评价。 从现实世界的拉动请求出发, 具体来说,一个端到端的Real2Sim(英语:Real2Sim)构造和质量保证(QA)管道为编码代理配备了SAM 3.1 [39],DA3 [40],一个被整理的资产库,以及重建场景的物理模型技能,作者参考解决方案,以及写出验证器,这是独立的QA代理对物理忠贞性的审计,重置一致性,以及验证器强健性以对抗奖励黑客. 同时,一个与港湾兼容的孤立拉带将代码执行沙盒与模拟器和验证器分开,将互动限制在公众观察和控制API,同时隐藏地面真实状态和分级逻辑以映射现实世界的制约和支持平行推出.

blocks.en:
From the same pipeline, we hold out 500 unseen, expert-verified tasks (200 single-arm and 300 dual-arm) across all eight task families to establish the zero-shot benchmark RoboUniverse-Verified , on which we systematically evaluate 11 leading closed- and open-source models.
Our evaluation reveals two core findings. First, a sharp capability gap persists: frontier closed-source models such as GPT-6.2 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 reach 85.8% and 76.8% overall success, whereas open-source baselines lag at 2.6% to 10.0% and struggle sharply on dual-arm coordination. Second, failures stem predominantly from physical execution rather than task comprehension. Weaker models are bottlenecked by low-level grasping, dropping to 0% to 4% success on grasp-required tasks. Even frontier models struggle with deformable-object manipulation, where cloth tasks barely benefit from capability gains, and roughly 80% of their failures occur after contact, pointing to fine-grained post-contact physical control as the primary remaining bottleneck.
blocks.zh:
从同一个管道中,我们在所有8个任务家族中执行500项秘密的专家核查任务(200个单臂和300个双臂),以建立零射线基准Robo University-Veriferation,我们系统地评估11个主要的封闭和开源模型。
我们的评价揭示了两项核心结论。 首先,存在巨大的能力差距:前沿封闭源码模型,如GPT-6.2 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5, 达到85.8%和76.8%的总体成功率,而开放源码基线滞后于2.6%至10.0%,在双臂协调方面挣扎不休。 第二,失败主要来自实际执行而不是任务理解。 疲软模型被低水平的抓取所束缚,在抓取要求的任务上下降到0%到4%的成功率. 即使是边疆模型也与可变形物体的操纵作斗争,布料任务几乎无法从能力增益中获益,大约80%的失败发生在接触后,这说明接触后精细的物理控制是主要的剩余瓶颈。

blocks.en:
To validate the utility of RoboUniverse-10K as a scalable post-training infrastructure, we conduct supervised post-training and generalization experiments. Using GPT-6 Astra [ 41 ] , we collect about 17K multi-turn interaction trajectories across the training environments, totaling 0.79B tokens, and perform full-parameter supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on the open-source Qwen3.6-35B-A3B model, yielding RoboUniverse-35B-A3B .
SFT yields substantial zero-shot gains on RoboUniverse-Verified, lifting the overall success rate from 0.8% to 21.2% (single-arm from 2.0% to 40.5% and dual-arm from 0.0% to 8.3%).
Furthermore, zero-shot probes on LIBERO-MAX, RoboCasa, and RoboTwin 2.0 in the Embodied First Exam [ 8 ] format, alongside a sim-to-real test on a real Franka arm, achieve zero-shot task completions beyond our environments.
blocks.zh:
为了验证RoboUniverse-10K作为可扩展的训练后基础设施的效用,我们进行了有监督的训练后实验和归纳实验. 使用GPT-6 Astra [41],我们收集了大约17K个跨训练环境的多回合交互轨迹,总计0.79B令牌,并在开源Qwen3.6-35B-A3B型上执行全参数监督微调(SFT),生成RoboUniverse-35B-A3B.
SFT在Robo University-Veriferized上取得了大幅的零射增益,将总体成功率从0.8%提高到21.2%(单臂从2.0%提高到40.5%,双臂从0.0 %提高到8.3%).
此外,在LIBERO-MAX、RoboCasa和RoboTwin 2.0的模拟第一考试[8]格式上进行零射探针,同时在真正的Franka臂上进行模拟到实际测试,在我们的环境下完成零射任务。

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are threefold: • RoboUniverse-10K: We present an automated Real2Sim construction and agent-based quality assurance pipeline, and open-source 10,807 Harbor-compatible, isolated, RL-ready simulation environments, overcoming the scale bottleneck limitation of prior benchmarks. • RoboUniverse-Verified Benchmark: We curate an expert-verified zero-shot test suite of 500 tasks, benchmark 11 closed- and open-source models, and pinpoint low-level grasping, deformable-object manipulation, and post-contact physical control as the primary bottlenecks of current embodied coding agents. • RoboUniverse-35B-A3B Model: We train and open-source an SFT model on RoboUniverse-10K, lifting zero-shot success on RoboUniverse-Verified from 0.8% to 21.2% while achieving zero-shot task completions across external benchmarks and a real Franka arm.
blocks.zh: 简言之,我们的主要贡献有三: • RoboUniverse-10K:我们提出了一个自动化的Real2Sim建造和基于代理的质量保证管道,以及10,807个开源的港口兼容性,孤立性,RL准备的模拟环境,克服了先前基准的规模瓶颈限制. • 机械统一验证基准: 我们管理一套由500项任务、11个封闭式和开源式基准组成的经专家验证的零射试验套件,并确定低水平抓取、变形物体操纵和接触后物理控制是当前内含编码剂的主要瓶颈。 • 机械Universe-35B-A3B 型号 : 我们在RoboUniverse-10K上训练和开源SFT模型,将RoboUniverse-Verife上的零射成功率从0.8%提升到21.2%,同时实现跨越外部基准和真正的Franka臂的零射任务完成率.

blocks.en: 2.1 Environment Design and Execution Harness
blocks.zh: 2.1 环境设计和实施

blocks.en: RoboUniverse-10K provides interactive, resettable, and automatically verifiable physics environments for post-training and evaluating embodied coding agents. Each environment comprises four components: a natural-language task instruction, an Isaac Sim [ 38 ] physical scene, a robot observation and control interface, and a task-specific verifier. Together, they form a closed loop supporting fast resets and parallel rollouts for both large-scale trajectory collection (SFT) and online reinforcement learning (RL).
blocks.zh: RoboUniverse-10K提供交互,可重置,自动可核查的物理环境,用于后训练和评价包含的编码剂. 每个环境由四个部分组成:一个自然语言任务指令,一个Isaac Sim[38]物理场景,一个机器人观测和控制接口,以及一个任务特定验证器. 它们共同形成一个闭环,支持快速重置和平行推出,既用于大规模轨迹收集(SFT),也用于在线强化学习(RL).

blocks.en: We package each task in a format compatible with Harbor [ 42 ] , the containerized evaluation framework used in Terminal-Bench [ 43 ] , connecting the agent’s code-execution sandbox to the simulation backend via a unified harness ( Figure 2 ). Upon initialization, the runtime loads the scene and provides the agent with the task instruction and API documentation. Inside the sandbox terminal, the agent writes and runs Python programs that interact with the simulator exclusively through five exposed tools ( Table 1 ). The simulation backend executes joint actuation and physical contact at the specified control frequency and returns updated observations. Simulation time advances only during step and step_chunk calls, remaining paused during observation reads, code authoring, and model inference.

blocks.en: To mirror real-world robotic sensing constraints, the agent sandbox is strictly isolated from the simulation backend and grading logic. Ground-truth object states, reference solutions, and verifiers remain hidden on the environment side. Each episode permits a single attempt bounded by action-step and wall-clock budgets; the agent cannot reset the scene or query intermediate scores. When the agent calls finish() or exhausts its budget, the independent verifier inspects the execution logs and final simulator state to assign a terminal binary reward. By withholding success flags, progress signals, and privileged states, the harness requires the agent to judge physical outcomes and termination timing solely from sensor observations.
blocks.zh: 为映射真实世界的机器人感知限制,代理沙盒与模拟后端和分级逻辑严格隔离. 地面真实物体状态、参考解决方案和核查器仍然隐藏在环境方面。 每集都允许一次以动作步和时钟预算为界限的尝试;代理无法重设场景或查询中间分数. 当代理机呼叫完成()或用尽其预算时,独立核查员检查执行日志和最终模拟状态,以分配终端二进制奖励. 通过屏蔽成功的旗帜,进步信号,以及特权状态,控制手段要求代理人仅仅通过传感器观测来判断物理结果和终止时间.

blocks.en: RoboUniverse-10K comprises 10,807 distinct simulation environments, split into 10,307 training tasks and 500 held-out zero-shot evaluation tasks (RoboUniverse-Verified). DROID [ 44 ] is the primary source of demonstrations for the single-arm Franka tasks. We also reconstruct tasks from demonstrations in BridgeData V2 [ 45 ] , BC-Z [ 46 ] , RT-1 [ 47 ] , Berkeley Fanuc [ 48 ] , Berkeley Cable Routing [ 49 ] , RoboCook [ 50 ] , Berkeley Autolab UR5 [ 51 ] , Columbia PushT [ 52 ] , RoboTurk [ 53 ] , and CMU Stretch [ 54 ] . The dual-arm AgileX tasks draw on bimanual teleoperation datasets including RoboDesk [ 55 ] , RoboCOIN [ 56 ] , GM100 [ 57 ] , RoboDojo [ 25 ] , ViFailback [ 58 ] , MM-30 [ 59 ] , and RoboMIND2 [ 60 ] . Detailed task counts across embodiments and categories are shown in Figure 3 .
blocks.zh: RoboUniverse-10K包含10,807个截然不同的模拟环境,分为10,307个训练任务和500个被搁置的零镜头评价任务(RoboUniverse-Verified). DROID [44] 是单臂Franka任务的主要示威来源. 我们还在BridgeData V2 [45],BC-Z [46],RT-1 [47],Berkeley Fanuc [48],Berkeley的示威中重建任务. Cable Routing [49], RoboCook [50], Berkeley Autolab UR5 [51], Columbia PushT [52], RoboTurk [53],和CMU扩展 [54]. 双臂猛烈 X任务利用双人远程操作数据集,包括RoboDesk [55],RoboCOIN [56],GM100 [57],RoboDojo [25],ViFailback [58],MM-30 [59],和RoboMIND2 [60]. 图3显示各种表现形式和类别的详细任务数。

blocks.en: Multi-source robotics datasets often exhibit heavy redundancy and inconsistent task granularity. To reduce overlap while preserving task diversity, we organize demonstrations into a five-level hierarchy: Embodiment → \rightarrow Taxonomy → \rightarrow Concrete Task → \rightarrow Layout → \rightarrow Trajectory . We normalize task granularity at the Concrete Task level, treating a demonstration as distinct only when it introduces a different interaction type, a substantially different scene context, or a meaningful change in the manipulated objects. Demonstrations differing solely in camera viewpoint, surface appearance, minor spatial arrangements, initial object poses, or execution trajectories are treated as duplicates, with a single representative retained for each concrete task.
blocks.zh: 多源机器人数据集往往表现出大量冗余和不一致的任务颗粒性. 为了减少重叠,同时保持任务的多样性,我们组织演示为五层结构: 嵌入 → 右侧分类学 → 右侧混凝土任务 → 右侧布局 → 右侧轨道 。 我们在具体任务一级使任务颗粒性正常化,只有当演示引入了不同的相互作用类型、大不相同的场景背景或被操纵物体发生有意义的变化时,才将演示视为不同。 仅在镜头、表面外观、小空间安排、初始物体姿势或执行轨迹方面有差异的演示被视为重复,为每项具体任务保留一名代表。

blocks.en: Based on end-effector contact mechanics and bimanual coordination patterns, we organize the collection into two embodiment tracks covering eight task families, as shown in Figure 3 . Single-arm Franka tasks comprise four families. Pick & Place involves rigid-body relocation and 3D reorientation, while Assembly & Articulation covers constrained assembly and sustained-contact interaction with mechanisms such as drawers, doors, and buttons. Deformable & Material addresses shaping non-rigid objects like cloth and dough alongside wiping, pouring, and sweeping, and Composite chains multiple primitives within a single episode. Dual-arm AgileX tasks likewise span four families. Co-Transport & Handover covers joint lifting, relocation, and inter-arm passing or regrasping, whereas Co-Assembly & Stabilization focuses on bimanual assembly and asymmetric stabilization and manipulation. Co-Deformable & Transfer involves coordinated folding, flattening, and container-stabilized pouring, and Staged Coordination captures asynchronous, causally ordered multi-stage workflows.
blocks.zh: 根据终端效应接触力学和双人协调模式,我们把收集工作组织成两个化身轨道,涵盖八个任务家庭,如图3所示。 单臂Franka任务包括四个家庭。 Pick & Place涉及刚性的身体迁移和3D重定向,而Assembly & Articulation则涵盖受限的组装和与抽屉,门,按钮等机制的持续接触互动. 可变形的 & Material 地址 塑造非刚性物体, 如布和面团, 双臂动作 X任务同样涉及四个家庭。 共同运输和移交包括联合起重、迁移和武器之间通过或重新放牧,而共同大会和稳定则侧重于双人组装以及不对称的稳定和操纵。 可共同变异和转移涉及协调折叠,平整,以及容器稳定浇灌,阶段协调抓取同步,因果有序的多阶段工作流程.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Real-to-Sim Data and Quality Assurance Pipeline. From each real video, a coding agent writes a task specification and builds the scene, reference controller, and verifier with perception tools, an asset library, and physics skills. An independent QA agent checks fidelity, reset and replay, and the verifier, and sends failing environments back for revision. Accepted environments are packaged as Harbor tasks.
blocks.zh: 图4:实向实向数据和质量保证管道. 从每个真实的视频中,一个编码代理写出任务规格,并用感知工具,资产库和物理技能来构建场景,参考控制器和验证器. 一个独立的QA代理检查忠诚度,重置和重播,以及验证器,并发送失败的环境回来进行修正. 接受的环境被包装为港湾任务 。

blocks.en: 2.3 Real-to-Sim Data and Quality Assurance Pipeline
blocks.zh: 2.3 实到实数据和质量保证管道

blocks.en: RoboUniverse-10K transforms real-world robot manipulation videos into executable, verifiable RL environments through an automated Real2Sim construction and quality-assurance (QA) pipeline.
blocks.zh: RoboUniverse-10K通过一个自动化的Real2Sim构造和质量保证(QA)管道,将现实世界的机器人操纵视频转化为可执行,可核查的RL环境.

blocks.en: We first filter real-world manipulation videos to retain episodes with complete executions and clear goals, removing duplicate or near-duplicate scenes while maintaining broad coverage across task families. A coding agent then inspects each video to identify the manipulated objects, initial state, and desired outcome, formulating a natural-language task instruction. Each specification preserves the core objective and necessary constraints of the real demonstration while permitting any valid strategy to complete the task.
blocks.zh: 我们首先过滤真实世界的操纵视频,以保留有完全处决和明确目标的事件,去除重复或几乎重复的场景,同时保持对任务家庭的广泛报道。 然后,一个编码代理人检查每个视频,以识别被操纵的对象、初始状态和预期成果,制定自然语言任务指示。 每个规格都保留了实际示范的核心目标和必要的限制,同时允许任何有效的战略来完成任务。

blocks.en: We equip the coding agent with a unified Real2Sim harness integrating SAM 3.1 [ 39 ] segmentation, DA3 [ 40 ] depth estimation, a pre-built asset library, and Isaac Sim. Using segmentation masks and depth maps to recover object contours and spatial layouts, the agent selects robots, object meshes, textures, and lighting from the asset library—supplementing geometry via external retrieval or procedural code when needed. To ensure physical fidelity, we provide physics-modeling skills that guide the agent in configuring collision geometry, mass and inertia, friction, joint limits, and drive parameters, as well as verifying support, contact, and release dynamics. Supported by these tools, the agent authors the scene, reference control program, and verifier, iterating on rendered-versus-source visual comparisons and physics-execution feedback until the robot solves the task through genuine contact, friction, and dynamics rather than scripted motion.
blocks.zh: 我们为编码器配备了统一的 Real2Sim 控制带 整合了SAM 3.1 [39] 分区,DA3 [40] 深度估计,一个预建的资产库,和Isaac Sim. 代理人利用分区面具和深度图恢复物体轮廓和空间布局,从资产库中选择机器人、物体网格、纹理和照明——必要时通过外部检索或程序代码补充几何。 为了确保物理上的忠诚,我们提供了物理模型技术,指导物剂配置碰撞几何,质量和惯性,摩擦,联动极限,和驱动参数,以及验证支持,接触,释放动力学. 在这些工具的支援下,代理编导了场景,参考控制程序,以及验证器,重复了渲染与源视觉对比和物理执行反馈,直到机器人通过真正的接触,摩擦,动态而不是脚本动作来解决任务.

blocks.en: Each generated environment is audited by a separate QA agent against the source video, simulation rollout, scene code, and state logs. The audit enforces three checks: (1) fidelity , verifying that task semantics, key spatial relations, and physical completion match the source video; (2) reset and replay , confirming that the reference controller reliably reproduces the task after environment reset; and (3) verifier audit , testing failure cases and valid strategy variants to eliminate false positives and false negatives—specifically guarding against object penetration, teleportation, and transient success. Environments that fail any check are returned to the builder agent with diagnostic feedback for revision and re-audit; passing environments are packaged into isolated Harbor tasks.
blocks.zh: 每个生成的环境由一个单独的QA代理对源视频,模拟推出,场景代码和状态日志进行审计. 审计执行三项检查:(1) 真实性,核实任务语义、关键空间关系和实际完成情况与源视频相符;(2) 重设和重播,确认参考控制器在环境重置后可靠地复制任务;(3) 核查员审计,测试故障案例和有效战略变体,以消除假阳性和假阴性——具体地防范物体渗透、传送和瞬间成功。 任何检查失败的环境都会返回到构建者代理中,并附有用于修改和重新审计的诊断反馈;经过的环境会被包装成孤立的港务任务.

blocks.en: 3 The RoboUniverse-Verified Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3 机器人统一验证基准

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate on the 500 zero-shot evaluation tasks of RoboUniverse-Verified, comprising 200 single-arm Franka tasks and 300 dual-arm AgileX tasks that together cover all eight task families in Figure 3 . The single-arm tasks comprise 45 Pick & Place, 68 Assembly & Articulation, 68 Deformable & Material, and 19 Composite tasks; the dual-arm tasks comprise 93 Co-Transport & Handover, 99 Co-Assembly & Stabilization, 78 Co-Deformable & Transfer, and 30 Staged Coordination tasks.
We evaluate seven closed-source and four open-source models, listed in Table 2 . The GPT-series models run in their native Codex agent harness, and all other models run in Claude Code; the reasoning effort of each model is indicated in the table.
blocks.zh:
我们评价Robo Universe-Verifed的500项零镜头评价任务,包括200项单臂Franka任务和300项双臂AgileX任务,这些任务合在一起涵盖图3中的所有八个任务家庭。 单臂任务包括45项Pick & Place、68项装配和造型、68项变形和材料以及19项复合任务;双臂任务包括93项联运和移交、99项联运和稳定、78项联运和转型以及30项分阶段协调任务。
我们评价表2所列的七个封闭源代码和四个开源代码。 GPT系列模型运行于其本土的Codex代理吊带中,所有其他模型运行于Claude Code中;表格显示了每个模型的推理努力.

blocks.en: Each task permits a single attempt: the agent can neither reset the scene nor query intermediate scores. The control-step budget varies by task from 250 to 4,000 steps, with a median of 3,000. The evaluation metric is the task success rate as determined by the independent verifier.
blocks.zh: 每个任务允许一次尝试:代理既不能重置场景,也不能查询中间分数. 控制步骤预算按任务不同,从250步到4000步不等,中间数为3000步. 评价尺度是独立核查人确定的任务成功率。

blocks.en: 3.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 3.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 2 reports the success rate of each model on each of the eight task families, together with its overall success rate. Performance differs sharply across models: GPT-6.2 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 achieve overall success rates of 85.8% and 76.8%, GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol reach 54.6% and 49.4%, and none of the remaining seven models exceeds 10%, the best among them being DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at 10.0%. No model falls in the 10%–49% range, leaving a pronounced gap between the two groups.
blocks.zh: 表2报告了8个任务家庭中每个模式的成功率及其总体成功率。 不同模型的性能差异很大:GPT-6.2 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5实现85.8%和76.8%的总成功率,GPT-6 Astra和GPT-6.1 Sol达到54.6%和49.4%,其余7个模型都没有超过10%,其中最好的是DeepSeek V4.1 Flash达到10.0%. 10~49%范围内没有模型落下,使得两组之间有明显的差距.

blocks.en: Table 2 : Main results on RoboUniverse-Verified. Success rate (%) of each model with its coding-agent harness. Badges give the reasoning effort; Overall covers all 500 tasks; the best result in each column is in bold .
blocks.zh: 表2: Robo University-Verific化的主要结果。 每个型号及其编码剂牵引装置的成功率(%). 徽章给出了推理努力; 总体上涵盖了所有500项任务; 每栏的最佳成绩为粗体.

blocks.en: The weaker models fail almost completely on dual-arm tasks: their success rates fall from 6.0%–18.5% on single-arm tasks to 0.3%–5.3% on dual-arm tasks. This drop reflects the task composition. About 10% of the single-arm tasks are non-prehensile, such as toppling or pressing, and these tasks account for roughly one-third of the weaker models’ single-arm successes. In contrast, nearly all dual-arm tasks require grasping and, in addition, coordinating two arms in a 16-dimensional action space. GPT-6.2 Astra, Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, and GPT-6.1 Sol show no such decline: their dual-arm success rates are no lower than their single-arm success rates.
blocks.zh: 较弱的模型在双臂任务上几乎完全失败:它们的成功率从单臂任务的6.0~18.5%下降到双臂任务的0.3%~5.3%. 这一下降反映了任务构成。 大约10%的单臂任务不全面,如推倒或压压,这些任务占较弱型号单臂成功率的约三分之一。 相比之下,几乎所有的双臂任务都需要把握,此外,还需要在16维行动空间中协调双臂. GPT-6.2 Astra、Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Astra和GPT-6.1 Sol没有显示这种下降:他们的双臂成功率不低于他们的单臂成功率.

blocks.en: Three of these four models perform best on Co-Transport & Handover, and all four score 61.3%–96.8% on it; the exception is GPT-6 Astra, which performs slightly better on Pick & Place, scoring 66.7% there versus 65.6% on Co-Transport & Handover. Deformable & Material is comparatively difficult: GPT-6.2 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 score 6.4 and 10.6 percentage points below their respective overall success rates. On Co-Deformable & Transfer, GPT-6.2 Astra is 10.2 points below its overall success rate, whereas Claude Opus 5.5 is only 1.2 points below. Staged Coordination is one of the most discriminative families: GPT-6.2 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 reach 93.3% and 70.0%, whereas GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol achieve only 60.0% and 46.7%; among the remaining models, only Tencent Hy4 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash solve any task, completing 2 and 1 of the 30 tasks, respectively. Because a multi-stage task succeeds only if every stage is completed correctly, an error at any stage causes the entire task to fail, which amplifies capability differences between models.
blocks.zh: 这四个模型中有三个在Co-Transport & Handover上表现最好,所有四个得分均为61.3%–96.8%;例外的是GPT-6 Astra在Pick & Place上表现略好,在Co-Transport & Handover上得分66.7%,而65.6%. 可变形 & 材质比较困难:GPT-6.2 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5的得分比各自总体成功率低6.4和10.6个百分点. 在可共同变异和转移上,GPT-6.2 Astra比其整体成功率低10.2分,而克劳德·奥普斯5.5则只有下面1.2分. 分阶段协调是最歧视的家庭之一:GPT-6.2 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5达到93.3%和70.0%,而GPT-6 Astra和GPT-6.1 Sol仅实现60.0%和46.7%;在其余的模型中,只有Tencent Hy4和DeepSeek V4.1 Flash解决任何任务,分别完成30项任务中的2项和1项. 由于一个多阶段的任务只有在每个阶段都正确完成时才能成功,因此任何阶段的错误都会导致整个任务失败,这放大了模型之间的能力差异.

blocks.en: 3.3 Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.3 分析

blocks.en: We refer to the four models with success rates of 49%–86% as frontier models and to the remaining seven models in Table 2 , each with a success rate of at most 10%, as weaker models . On non-prehensile tasks that require only toppling or pressing, the weaker models still achieve a success rate of 32.1%; on task categories that require grasping, however, their success rate drops to 0%–4%, compared with 57%–77% for the frontier models. Figure 5 illustrates this contrast with two representative tasks. According to the physical measurements of the verifier, 46%–47% of the weaker models’ failures occur before they establish effective contact with the target object or lift it, compared with 18%–22% for the frontier models. Moreover, the weaker models typically exhaust their entire step budget in failed episodes, with a median usage of 98%–100% of the budget. These results indicate that the weaker models understand the task goal to some extent but struggle to translate visual observations and joint control into a stable grasp; their bottleneck lies in the low-level perception–action loop rather than in high-level planning.
blocks.zh: 我们把成功率为49-86%的4个模型称为前沿模型,并将表2中剩下的7个模型称为弱模型,每个模型的成功率最多为10%。 在只需要推倒或紧迫的非全面任务上,较弱的模型仍然取得了32.1%的成功率;然而,在需要把握的任务类别上,其成功率下降到0-%-4%,而前沿模型的成功率为57-%-77%。 图5显示了与两项具有代表性的任务的这种对比。 根据验证器的物理测量,较弱模型的故障有46~47%发生在它们与目标物体建立有效接触或升起之前,而前沿模型的故障率为18~22%。 此外,较弱的模型通常会在失败情况下耗尽整个步骤预算,使用率中位数为预算的98-100%。 这些结果表明,较弱的模型在某种程度上理解任务目标,但努力将视觉观察和联合控制转化为稳定的把握;它们的瓶颈在于低水平的感知-行动循环,而不是高层规划。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : The grasping gap. (a) Placing a mug upright on a slide requires a grasp: all four frontier models succeed, while all five weaker models evaluated on it fail. (b) Knocking over a can requires no grasp, and five of seven weaker models succeed.
blocks.zh: 图5:抓住差距。 (a) 把一个杯子直立放在幻灯片上需要抓住:所有四个前沿模型都成功,而对其评价的五个较弱模型都失败。 (b) 敲倒罐头不需要把握,7个较弱的模型中有5个成功。

blocks.en: Based on the task instructions, we annotate the 500 evaluation tasks with fine-grained manipulation types. The frontier models perform best on bimanual handover (77%), screwing and twisting (74%), and pick-and-place (68%), and worst on cloth manipulation (36%). We further compare two capability tiers: the mid-tier frontier models GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol, which average 52%, and the top models GPT-6.2 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5, which average 81%. From the mid tier to the top tier, success rates on assembly, tool-based process, and pick-and-place tasks increase by 35–38 percentage points, whereas the success rate on cloth tasks increases by only 3 percentage points, and all four frontier models remain at 28%–41% on cloth. Figure 6 shows a typical cloth task on which all four frontier models fail. This indicates that deformable-object manipulation, exemplified by cloth, has not improved with overall model capability and constitutes a capability ceiling shared by all current models.
blocks.zh: 根据任务说明,我们用精细的操控类型对500项评价任务进行注释。 边疆模式在双人交接(77%)、操弄和扭动(74%)和挑拣(68%)方面表现最好,在布料操纵(36%)方面表现最差。 我们进一步比较了两个能力等级:中级前沿模型GPT-6 Astra和GPT-6.1 Sol,平均为52%;顶级模型GPT-6.2 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5,平均为81%。 从中层到上层,装配成功率、基于工具的进程和选址任务都提高了35~38个百分点,而布料任务的成功率只提高了3个百分点,所有四个前沿模式都保持在布料的28~41%。 图6显示了四个前沿模型都失败的典型布料任务. 这表明,以布匹为例的可变形物体操纵没有随着整体模型能力的提高而改进,构成所有现有模型共用的能力上限。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Cloth folding. All four frontier models fail to fold a towel in half: GPT-6.2 Astra folds it diagonally, Claude Opus 5.5 crumples it, and GPT-6.1 Sol leaves the layers misaligned.
blocks.zh: 图6:克洛斯折叠。 所有四个边疆模型都未能半折叠一个毛巾:GPT-6.2 Astra对角折叠它,Claude Opus 5.5 crumples it,和GPT-6.1 Sol离开层错对.

blocks.en: The failures of the frontier models are not independent: 94 tasks, or 19% of the benchmark, are solved by at most one frontier model, and 26 of them are solved by none. Roughly 80% of frontier-model failures occur after the object has been successfully contacted, manifesting mainly as insufficient final-state precision, objects that fail to come to rest after release, and excessive pressing due to the absence of force feedback. As shown in Figure 7 , in a lid-placement task the successful and failed final states are nearly indistinguishable in the camera view, yet the lid in the failed episode is off-center by 6 mm and tilted by 5.6 ∘ , exceeding the tolerances of 2 mm and 4 ∘ . In a button-pressing task, GPT-6.2 Astra never makes contact with the button, whereas the other three frontier models press it beyond its 3.5 mm mechanical travel with contact forces of 70–138 N. All of these failures depend on continuous physical quantities such as pose accuracy, material proportions, and contact force, which are precisely the quantities that are difficult to judge and control from visual observations alone.
blocks.zh: 边疆模型的失败并不独立:94项任务,即基准的19%,最多通过一个边疆模型来解决,26项没有解决. 大约80%的前沿模型故障发生在对象成功接触之后,主要表现为最终状态精度不足,释放后无法休息的物体,以及由于缺乏力反馈而过度压迫. 如图7所示, 在封面布置任务中, 成功和失败的最终状态在镜头中几乎不可区分, 然而失败的插曲的封面却离中心6毫米, 在按键任务中,GPT-6.2 Astra从未接触过按键,而其他三种前沿型号则用70-138 N的接触力将其压在3.5毫米机械旅行之外. 所有这些故障都取决于连续的物理量,如形成精确度、物质比例和接触力,这些正是光凭视觉观察很难判断和控制的数量。

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Fine-grained control failures after contact. (a) GPT-6.2 Astra places the lid 6 mm off-center and tilted by 5.6 ∘ , beyond the tolerance, yet its final state looks almost identical to the successful one from Claude Opus 5.5. (b) GPT-6.2 Astra never reaches the button, while the other frontier models press it past its 3.5 mm travel with up to 138 N of force.
blocks.zh: 图7:接触后细纹控制故障. (a) GPT-6.2 Astra将盖子6毫米离中心,倾斜5.6 ∘,超出耐受性,但其最终状态与克劳德·奥普斯5.5的成功状态几乎相同。 (b) GPT-6.2 Astra从未到达按钮,而其他前沿型号则用高达138 N的武力压过3.5毫米的行程。

blocks.en: The weaker models attempt to bypass the task in 11.4% of their episodes, compared with only 0.1% for the frontier models. These attempts fall into two main categories. The first uses the task identifiers exposed by the environment to search the Internet for the evaluation tasks or reference solutions. The second uses the connection token to probe the HTTP interface of the simulation backend for privileged endpoints such as object states or scene resets. Figure 8 shows excerpts of such attempts. In contrast, the frontier models use web access almost exclusively to look up robot specifications such as URDF files. None of these attempts yields any privileged information, and only 5 of the 304 corresponding episodes succeed, a success rate of 1.6%, which is below the 6.6% that the same models achieve in their remaining episodes. This suggests that, when obstructed, the weaker models tend to seek shortcuts rather than solve the problem itself. It also shows that the execution–verification isolation of RoboUniverse-10K and its grading based on physical evidence are robust to information-based shortcuts.
blocks.zh: 较弱的模型试图在11.4%的节目中绕过任务,而前沿模型则只有0.1%。 这些尝试分为两大类。 第一种是使用环境暴露的任务识别符搜索互联网,以获取评价任务或参考解决方案. 第二种使用连接符来探测模拟后端的HTTP接口,用于对象状态或场景重置等特权端点. 图8显示了这些企图的摘录。 相比之下,边疆模型几乎完全使用网络访问来查找URDF文件等机器人规格. 这些尝试都没有产生任何特权信息,304个相应剧集中只有5个成功,成功率为1.6%,低于同一模式在剩余剧集中取得的6.6%。 这表明,当被阻挠时,较弱的模型往往寻求捷径而不是解决问题本身. 这也表明,对RoboUniverse-10K的处决-核查隔离及其基于物证的分级对于基于信息的捷径是强有力的。

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Attempts by weaker models to bypass the task. Models probe the simulation backend, search online for task identifiers, or crawl other benchmarks for similar tasks; none obtains privileged information.
blocks.zh: 图8:较弱的模型试图绕过任务. 模型探测模拟后端,在线搜索任务标识符,或者爬行类似任务的其他基准;没有获得特权信息.

blocks.en: 4 Post-Training on RoboUniverse-10K
blocks.zh: 4 机器人Universe-10K后训练

blocks.en: 4.1 Training Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 培训设置

blocks.en: We collect approximately 17,000 multi-turn robot manipulation trajectories within RoboUniverse-10K, totaling 0.79B tokens. All trajectories are generated using GPT-6 Astra (Medium) and standardized into the multi-turn tool-use format of Claude Code.
blocks.zh: 我们在RoboUniverse-10K内部收集了大约17,000个多回合机器人操纵轨迹,总计0.79B个令牌. 所有轨迹都使用GPT-6 Astra(Medium)生成,并标准化为Claude Code的多回合工具使用格式.

blocks.en: We initialize from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and perform full-parameter supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on the language backbone while keeping the vision encoder and aligner frozen. Optimization uses AdamW with a peak learning rate of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} , a 5% linear warmup, and a cosine decay schedule down to 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} . We train with a global batch size of 64 and a maximum context length of 256k tokens, consuming approximately 1,500 equivalent NVIDIA H100 GPU hours.
blocks.zh: 我们从Quen3.6-35B-A3B初始化,并在语言主干线上进行全参数监督微调(SFT),同时使视觉编码器和对齐器保持冷冻. 优化使用 AdamW,峰值学习率为 1×10 − 5 1\times 10×5},线性热量为5%, 余弦衰变进度降至 1×10 − 6 1\times 10×6}. 我们的培训全球批量规模为64个,最大上下文长度为256k令牌,消耗约1500个等效的NVIDIA H100 GPU小时.

blocks.en: 4.2 Results on RoboUniverse-Verified
blocks.zh: 4.2 机器人统一验证结果

blocks.en: We follow the zero-shot evaluation protocol of Section 3.1 , evaluating each model with a single attempt per task under the Claude Code harness. As shown in Figure 9 , SFT on RoboUniverse-10K raises the overall success rate of the base model from 0.8% to 21.2%, surpassing all open-source baselines as well as the closed-source GPT-6 Luna, and more than doubling the next-best open-source model, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash. Notably, this result is achieved by a model that activates only 3B parameters per token; nevertheless, a clear gap remains to the four frontier closed-source models.
blocks.zh: 我们遵循第3.1节的零镜头评价协议,在克洛德密码下对每个模型进行一次性评价。 如图9所示,RoboUniverse-10K上的SFT将基础模型的总体成功率从0.8%提升至21.2%,超过了所有开源基线以及闭源GPT-6 Luna,并且将次佳开源模型DeepSeek V4.1 Flash翻了一番以上. 值得注意的是,这一结果是通过一个每个信使只激活3B参数的模型实现的;然而,四个前沿封闭源码模型仍有明显差距。

blocks.en: Figure 9 : Overall success rate (%) on RoboUniverse-Verified. SFT raises the success rate of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B from 0.8% to 21.2%.
blocks.zh: 图9:机器人Universe-核查器的总体成功率(%)。 SFT将Quen3.6-35B-A3B的成功率从0.8%提高到21.2%.

blocks.en: The per-family results in Table 3 further reveal a marked asymmetry in these gains. The single-arm success rate rises from 2.0% to 40.5%; on Pick & Place in particular, it climbs from 0% to 62.2%, on par with GPT-6 Astra at max reasoning effort (66.7%), whose medium-effort variant generated the training trajectories. In contrast, the dual-arm success rate increases only from 0.0% to 8.3%, and none of the four dual-arm families exceeds 13%. This contrast raises a central question: what does SFT transfer to the model, and which capabilities lie beyond the reach of supervised imitation?
blocks.zh: 表3中的每个家庭的结果进一步显示,这些收益明显不对称。 单臂成功率从2.0%升至40.5%;特别是在Pick & Place上,它从0%升至62.2%,与GPT-6 Astra在最大推理努力(66.7%)相当,后者的中效变体产生训练轨迹。 相比之下,双臂成功率仅从0.0 %增至8.3%,四个双臂家庭中没有一个超过13%。 这一对比提出了一个中心问题:SFT向模型转移什么,哪些能力是监督仿制所无法达到的?

blocks.en: Table 3 : Success rate (%) of each task family on RoboUniverse-Verified. The first four columns are single-arm tasks, and the last four are dual-arm tasks.
blocks.zh: 表 3: 机器人Universe-验证系统每个任务组的成功率(%)。 前四栏为单臂任务,后四栏为双臂任务.

blocks.en: To trace how behavior changes with SFT, we consider two groups of tasks: those that newly succeed after SFT and those that fail both before and after SFT. We draw a stratified sample of 62 tasks from the two groups across task families and analyze the resulting 124 trajectories, one before and one after SFT for each task. On the newly solved single-arm tasks ( Table 4 ), RoboUniverse-35B-A3B consistently follows a three-stage procedure: model, refine, and verify . It first derives the forward kinematics and Jacobian of the Franka Panda from its public parameters, converting Cartesian targets into joint commands; it then advances in small steps of 3–12 cm, correcting each step in closed loop with visual feedback; finally, it releases the object, lets the scene settle, and re-checks the final state before terminating the episode.
blocks.zh: 为了追踪与SFT的行为如何变化,我们考虑了两组任务:在SFT之后新成功的任务和在SFT前后都失败的任务. 我们从两组任务中抽取了62项分级的样本,并分析了由此得出的124项路线,每项任务在SFT之前和之后各1项。 关于新解决的单臂任务(表4),RoboUniverse-35B-A3B始终遵循一个三阶段程序:模型,精细,验证. 它首先从它的公共参数中获取弗兰卡熊猫的前进动能和雅各比安,将笛卡尔目标转换成联合命令;然后以3–12厘米的小步前进,用视觉反馈在闭环中纠正每步;最后,它释放对象,让场景平息,并在结束插曲前重新检查最终状态.

blocks.en: This procedure directly remedies three critical deficiencies of the base model ( Figure 10 ). Without a kinematic model, the base model can only probe blindly in joint space; without a visual feedback loop, it cannot correct course from anomalous observations; and without verifying the final state, it prematurely declares success before the task is complete. Interestingly, longer reasoning does not yield better physical control: the median output of the base model is 14 times that of the SFT model (55.7k vs. 4.1k tokens), yet much of this text is spent restating observations and on unproductive self-correction. Once SFT has internalized this standard procedure, the gains on single-arm tasks follow readily.
blocks.zh: 这一程序直接弥补了基准模型的三个重大缺陷(图10)。 没有动态模型,基础模型只能盲目在联合空间中探测;没有视觉反馈环路,它无法从异常观测中校正路径;没有验证最终状态,它在任务完成前过早宣布成功. 有趣的是,较长的推理并不能产生更好的物理控制:基数模型的中位输出是SFT模型的14倍(55.7k vs 4.1k acidents),然而这个文本中的大部分是用在重复观察和无效果的自我校正上. 一旦SFT将这一标准程序内部化,单臂任务的收益就随即出现。

blocks.en: Table 4 : Behavior statistics on newly solved single-arm tasks. Computed on a stratified sample of trajectories.
blocks.zh: 表4:新解决的单臂任务的行为统计. 以分级的轨迹样本计算.

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Closing a drawer before and after SFT. (a) RoboUniverse-35B-A3B models the drawer, moves in small steps, corrects its push direction, and confirms the final state. (b) Qwen3.6-35B-A3B acts directly, reaches into the drawer, and declares success before it is closed.
blocks.zh: 图10:SFT前后关闭抽屉. (a) RoboUniverse-35B-A3B 型号为抽屉,小步移动,纠正其推向,确认最终状态. (b) Qune3.6-35B-A3B直接操作,进入抽屉,并在关闭前宣布成功。

blocks.en: On the dual-arm tasks that fail both before and after SFT, RoboUniverse-35B-A3B does not abandon this procedure: 11 of the 24 sampled trajectories parse the URDF of the AgileX Piper arm to build a kinematic model, the number of trajectories that exhaust the step budget drops from 6 to 1, and sub-steps such as single-arm grasping are mostly completed. Failures instead arise further upstream, in 3D perception and bimanual coordination. All models receive the same RGB images and joint angles, so the frontier models must likewise infer 3D positions from images; the base model of RoboUniverse-35B-A3B, however, struggles to establish accurate spatial relations from these images and falls back on coarse conversions such as “an offset of 20 pixels is roughly 3 cm,” which leads to missed grasps and slips in 8 dual-arm trajectories, compared with only 1 of the 22 newly solved single-arm trajectories. Moreover, cooperative actions such as handovers require the two arms to meet precisely in 3D space, avoid collisions, and strictly follow a grasp-before-release sequence, and the model lacks a global understanding of these constraints ( Figure 11 ).
blocks.zh: 在SFT前后都失败的双臂任务上,RoboUniverse-35B-A3B并没有放弃这个程序:在24个抽样的轨迹中,有11个剖析了AgileX Piper臂的URDF来构建运动模型,耗尽步预算的轨迹数量从6个下降到1个,单臂抓取等子步骤大多完成. 相反,在三维感知和双人协调方面,失败在上游进一步出现。 所有模型都接收到相同的RGB图像和联合角度,因此边疆模型同样必须推断出图像中的3D位置;然而RoboUniverse-35B-A3B的基础模型却挣扎于从这些图像中建立准确的空间关系,并回到粗糙的转换上,如"20像素的抵消大约是3厘米,"导致8个双臂轨迹错失了把握和滑动,而22个新解的单臂轨迹中只有1个. 此外,移交等合作行动要求双臂在3D空间精确相遇,避免碰撞,并严格遵循"抓住前释放"顺序,模式缺乏对这些制约因素的全球理解(图11).

blocks.en: Two lines of evidence indicate that this bottleneck is rooted in the visual capability ceiling of the base model . First, on the single-arm tasks that fail both before and after SFT, success correlates strongly with model capability: Claude Opus 5.5 solves 71% of them, GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol solve 38% and 33%, respectively, and the weaker models generally remain in the single digits. Second, the large gap between the single-arm and dual-arm performance of RoboUniverse-35B-A3B mirrors the pattern of the weaker models in Section 3.2 , whereas the frontier closed-source models perform no worse on dual-arm than on single-arm tasks. Overcoming this ceiling will require a stronger vision–language base model or external geometric tools such as depth estimation, camera calibration, and motion planning.
blocks.zh: 两条证据线表明,这一瓶颈根植于基本模型的视觉能力上限。 首先,关于SFT前后失败的单臂任务,成功与模型能力密切相关: Claude Opus 5.5解决了其中的71%,GPT-6 Astra和GPT-6.1 索尔分别解决38%和33%,较弱的模型一般仍停留在单位数中. 第二,RoboUniverse-35B-A3B的单臂和双臂性能之间的巨大差距反映了3.2节中较弱的模型的模式,而前沿闭源模型在双臂上的表现并不比单臂任务更差. 克服这个上限需要更强大的视觉-语言基础模型或外部几何工具,如深度估计、相机校准和运动规划。

blocks.en: Figure 11 : A typical dual-arm handover failure. When passing the cube to the right hand, RoboUniverse-35B-A3B misjudges depth, hits the left arm, and drops the cube twice.
blocks.zh: 图11:典型的双臂交接失败. 在将立方体传递到右手时,RoboUniverse-35B-A3B误判深度,击中左臂,将立方体降下两次.

blocks.en: 4.3 Generalization
blocks.zh: 4.3 概论

blocks.en: To test whether the learned manipulation behavior transfers beyond RoboUniverse-10K, we probe RoboUniverse-35B-A3B zero-shot on LIBERO-MAX [ 21 ] , RoboCasa [ 22 ] , and RoboTwin 2.0 [ 24 ] in the Embodied First Exam (EFE) [ 8 ] evaluation format. These suites differ entirely from RoboUniverse-10K in simulator backend, scenes, and action interface. Whereas the base Qwen3.6-35B-A3B model fails across all three suites, RoboUniverse-35B-A3B achieves zero-shot task completions on each of them. Inspecting these successful trajectories ( Figure 12 ) reveals that the model consistently reuses the same closed-loop strategy despite differences in scenes, objects, and single- versus dual-arm embodiments: it calibrates the image-to-physical correspondence online via small known motions, refines alignment on pixel errors, and retries when visual feedback indicates failure. Specifically, in LIBERO-MAX, the model detects a newly introduced distractor during its approach, re-localizes the target, and recovers when the pudding falls outside the basket by picking it up again. In RoboCasa, it calibrates the pixel-to-metric scale from a single known displacement and, after a missed grasp, autonomously corrects the offset between the camera and the fingertips. In RoboTwin 2.0, it probes the motion direction in image space with a small single-joint movement, iteratively aligns with the switch, and presses deeper after the switch rebounds on the first attempt. These behaviors closely mirror the single-arm trajectories in Section 4.2 , showing that SFT teaches a transferable control procedure rather than memorizing specific scenes.
blocks.zh: 为了测试所学到的操纵行为是否转移到RoboUniverse-10K之外,我们用LIBERO-MAX[21],RoboCasa[22]和RoboTwin 2.0[24]在健美第一考试(EFE)[8]评价格式上探测RoboUniverse-35B-A3B零镜头. 这些套件在模拟器后端,场景,动作界面方面与RoboUniverse-10K完全不同. 而基础的Qwen3.6-35B-A3B模型在所有三个套件上都失败了,RoboUniverse-35B-A3B则在每一个套件上实现了零镜头任务完成. 查看这些成功的轨迹(图12)发现,尽管场景,物体,以及单臂和双臂的浮雕不同,该模型始终不断地重复使用相同的闭路策略:它通过已知的小运动在线校准图像对物理的函证,完善像素误差的校正,在视觉反馈显示失败时进行重试. 具体地说,在LIBERO-MAX中,模型在接近时检测到新引入的分流器,重新定位目标,当布丁掉到篮子外时通过再次捡起来来恢复. 在RoboCasa中,它从一个已知的单个位移来校准像素到度量尺度,并在错失了抓取后,自主地纠正了相机和指尖之间的偏移. 在RoboTwin 2.0中,它用一个小的单联运动来探测图像空间中的运动方向,迭代地与开关对齐,在第一次尝试时,开关反弹后按得更深. 这些行为紧密地反映了第4.2节中的单臂轨迹,表明SFT教的是可转移控制程序,而不是记忆特定场景.

blocks.en: Figure 12 : Successful trajectories of RoboUniverse-35B-A3B across external benchmarks. The agent calibrates, aligns in pixel space, and retries after failures. LIBERO-Max wrist-camera images are upside down as rendered.
blocks.zh: 图12: RoboUniverse-35B-A3B跨外部基准的成功轨迹。 代理校准,在像素空间中对齐,并在失败后重试. LIBERO-Max手腕-相机图像被倒置成渲染.

blocks.en: Figure 13 : Drawing of the Einsia logo on a real Franka arm. Top: external camera; bottom: wrist camera.
blocks.zh: 图13:在真正的弗兰卡手臂上绘制爱因西亚标志. 顶部:外部相机;底部:腕相机.

blocks.en: We deploy RoboUniverse-35B-A3B, trained only in simulation, zero-shot on a real Franka arm to perform a task never seen in the training set: drawing the Einsia logo on a whiteboard from a reference image ( Figure 13 ). During execution, the model carries over the closed-loop control paradigm learned in simulation. It first extracts the contour of the image and plans the trajectory with inverse kinematics, while autonomously subsampling waypoints to fit the step budget. With the whiteboard height unknown, it calibrates the pen-down height by zooming in on the pen tip and making short test strokes along the target contour, which avoids stray marks. It then executes the drawing in stroke-wise chunks, checking the shape and position of each chunk against the camera image, and finally raises the arm to verify the final state. This indicates that the programming and visual closed-loop control abilities acquired through SFT generalize directly to new tasks and to a real physical robot.
blocks.zh: 我们部署 RoboUniverse-35B-A3B, 仅接受模拟训练, 对真正的Franka臂进行零镜头训练, 以完成训练中从未见过的任务: 从参考图像(图13)绘制白板上的爱因西亚标志。 在执行期间,模型承载了模拟中学习的闭路控制范式. 它首先提取图像的轮廓,并用反动量来规划轨迹,同时自主地对路标进行分样以适应步预算. 由于白板高度不明,它通过在笔尖上缩放来校准笔下高度,并沿目标轮廓进行短暂的测试中风,这避免了偏差的痕迹. 然后用中风图块执行图块,对照相机图像检查每个图块的形状和位置,最后提升手臂以验证最终状态. 这表明,通过SFT获得的编程和视觉闭路控制能力直接概括到新的任务和真正的物理机器人.

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: Existing simulation benchmarks for robot manipulation are mostly constructed by hand, with task counts remaining in the tens to hundreds ( Table 5 ). From Meta-World and RLBench [ 61 , 62 ] to LIBERO, RoboCasa, RoboTwin 2.0, and RoboDojo [ 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 , 25 ] , these suites have steadily expanded in scenes, objects, embodiments, and demonstrations, yet each task and its success condition are still implemented by hand; although BEHAVIOR-1K defines 1,000 activities, its experiments and challenges evaluate only 3 to 100 of them [ 63 , 64 ] . To reduce manual engineering, one line of work uses LLMs or coding agents to generate task code or complete simulated environments [ 26 , 27 , 31 , 32 , 65 , 66 ] , while another reconstructs simulations or tasks from real videos [ 28 , 67 , 29 , 30 , 68 , 33 , 69 ] , typically yielding at most a few hundred manipulation tasks. Within this group, Real2Gym also uses GPT-6 Astra [ 41 ] to reconstruct environments from real videos, but it builds only 24 environments and uses them to accumulate skills, not to train models [ 30 ] . Larger collections exist, but their tasks take different forms: LIBERO-Plus perturbs existing LIBERO tasks [ 70 ] , in PARTNR an LLM completes tasks by invoking high-level skills [ 71 ] , and EnvDreamer generates environments primarily to pretrain navigation and rearrangement policies [ 72 ] . RoboUniverse-10K uses coding agents to reconstruct tasks from real manipulation videos and contains about 10,807 tasks.
blocks.zh: 现有的机器人操纵模拟基准大多是手工构建的,任务计数仍为数十至数百个(表5)。 从Meta-World和RL Bench[61,62]到LIBERO,RoboCasa,RoboTwin 2.0,以及RoboDojo[21,22,23,24,25],这些套房在场景,物品,浮雕和演示中稳步扩张,然而每项任务及其成功条件仍然靠手执行;虽然BEHAVIOR-1K定义了1000项活动,但其实验和挑战仅评价其中3至100项[63,64]. 为了减少手工工程,一行工作使用LLMS或编码代理生成任务代码或完整的模拟环境[26,27,31,32,65,66],另一行则从真实视频中重建模拟或任务[28,67,29,30,68,33,69],一般最多产生几百个操纵任务. 在这个组内,Real2Gym还使用GPT-6 Astra[41]从真实的视频中重建环境,但它只构建了24个环境,并利用它们积累技能,而不是训练模型[30]. 收藏量较大,但其任务有不同形式: LIBERO-Plus干扰了现有的LIBERO任务[70],在PartNR中,LLM通过使用高级技能来完成任务[71],而EnvDreamer主要为预训导航和重排政策创造环境[72]. RoboUniverse-10K使用编码代理从真实的操纵视频中重建任务,并包含约10,807项任务.

blocks.en: Research on using frontier models as robot control agents has progressed quickly, yet evaluations still mostly reuse benchmarks designed for visuomotor policies. This direction has evolved from Code as Policies and VoxPoser [ 1 , 2 ] to recent agent harnesses that provide only a terminal and robot interface documentation [ 4 ] , supply skill libraries, VLA components, or accumulated experience [ 73 , 74 , 75 , 76 ] , or support open models [ 5 , 77 , 78 ] ; on the RoboDojo leaderboard, the top-ranked agent systems now outscore VLAs [ 7 ] . Because these policy-oriented protocols terminate an episode as soon as the simulator detects success, and some harnesses also return that verdict to the agent, reported scores remain sensitive to both the execution budget and the information exposed to the agent [ 9 , 37 ] . Recent studies build robot benchmarks tailored to coding agents, including CaP-X, EmbodiedSWE, Embodied First Exam (EFE), and Gym-Anything for Robotics [ 3 , 32 , 8 , 31 , 78 ] ; among these, EFE and Gym-Anything for Robotics isolate the verifier from the evaluated agent, and Gym-Anything for Robotics also provides 175 training environments. RoboUniverse-10K adopts the task format of EFE and Harbor [ 8 , 42 , 43 ] with the verifier hidden from the evaluated agent, provides a much larger set of training environments, and holds out a subset of tasks from the same pipeline as a test set.
blocks.zh: 关于利用前沿模型作为机器人控制剂的研究进展迅速,但评价大多仍然是为机动剂政策设计的再利用基准。 这个方向已经从代码作为Policy and VoxPoser [1,2] 发展到最近的代理机控制器,它只提供终端和机器人接口文件[4],提供技能库,VLA组件,或积累经验[73,74,75,76],或支持开放模式[5,77,78];在RoboDojo领导板上,排名最高的代理机系统现在超过得分的VLA[7]. 因为这些政策导向的协议在模拟器发现成功后立即终止一集,一些利用者也将判决还给代理商,因此报告得分对执行预算和接触代理商的信息都保持敏感[9,37]. 最近的研究建立了适合编码剂的机器人基准,包括CaP-X、EmfirmSWE、Emfirm Firm Exam(EFE)、机器人的Gym-Anything[3、32、8、31、78];其中,机器人的EFE和Gym-Anything将核查剂与被评价的代理物隔离开来,机器人的Gym-Anything也提供了175个培训环境。 RoboUniverse-10K采用了EFE和Harbour[8,42,43]的任务格式,其验证器隐藏在被评价的代理中,提供了一套大得多的训练环境,并且从同一个管道中保留了一组与测试集相同的任务.

blocks.en: Software engineering has established a relatively mature post-training pipeline for agents: building executable, automatically graded environments at scale and training open models via teacher-trajectory distillation or reinforcement learning. These training environments have scaled from the semi-manually configured instances of SWE-Gym [ 10 ] to tasks synthesized within existing repositories [ 11 , 12 ] or mined automatically from real pull requests [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] , reaching hundreds of thousands of instances; training on them with distillation [ 12 , 14 ] or reinforcement learning [ 17 , 18 ] has substantially improved open models on SWE-bench [ 20 ] . Robotics has recently adopted the same pipeline: CaPtain and AgenticRoboRL apply SFT followed by reinforcement learning [ 34 , 35 ] , PEAR applies reinforcement learning directly in simulation [ 36 ] , and EmbodiedSWE adapts coding-agent task synthesis to construct training environments [ 32 ] , yet these studies still train on at most a few hundred tasks. This gap arises in part because robot tasks are more costly to construct: each requires an interactive physical scene and a success check, whereas software tasks can be extracted automatically from code repositories and their history. Following Scale-SWE, which automatically builds environments from real pull requests [ 14 ] , RoboUniverse-10K constructs training tasks from real manipulation videos in place of pull requests, and we fine-tune open models on GPT-6 Astra trajectories collected on these tasks.
blocks.zh: 软件工程为代理商建立了相对成熟的培训后管道:建设可执行的,规模化的自动分级的环境,通过教师-导师衍射或强化学习来培训开放式模型. 这些培训环境已从半手工配置的SWE-Gym [10] 缩放到在现有储存库内合成的任务[11,12]或从实际拉拉请求中自动挖掘出来的[13,14,15],达到数十万例;关于这些培训的蒸馏[12,14]或强化学习[17,18]大大改进了SWE-bench上的开放模式[20]。 机器人最近采用了同样的管道:CaPtain和AgenticRoboRL应用SFT,然后是加固学习[34,35],PEAR应用加固学习直接用于模拟[36],EmbodySWE调整编码代理任务合成以构建培训环境[32],然而这些研究最多仍然在几百项任务上训练. 出现这一空白的部分原因是机器人任务造型成本较高:每个任务都需要一个互动的物理场景和成功检查,而软件任务可以自动从代码寄存器及其历史中提取. 在Scale-SWE从真实的拉力请求中自动构建环境[14]之后,RoboUniverse-10K从真实的操纵视频中构建了训练任务,以取代拉力请求,我们对这些任务收集的GPT-6 Astra轨迹的开放模型进行了微调.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和限制

blocks.en: In this work, we introduce RoboUniverse-10K , an automated real-to-sim pipeline and a large-scale collection of interactive, isolated, and verifiable Isaac Sim environments built from real-world manipulation videos, moving Agentic Robotics beyond manual scale limits and “train-on-test” evaluation. Zero-shot benchmarking on RoboUniverse-Verified reveals a sharp gap between frontier and open-source models, pinpointing low-level grasping, deformable-object manipulation, and post-contact physical control as key bottlenecks. Furthermore, supervised fine-tuning on RoboUniverse-10K yields RoboUniverse-35B-A3B , substantially improving zero-shot success and achieving zero-shot task completions across external benchmarks and a real Franka arm. By open-sourcing the RL-ready environments and model, we aim to lay a scalable foundation for online reinforcement learning in embodied intelligence.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们引入了RoboUniverse-10K,一个自动化的真人至真人管道,以及从现实世界操纵视频中构建的大规模互动、孤立和可核查的Isaac Sim环境集,将代理机器人超越了人工规模限制和“试训”评价。 机器人Universe-Veriferized上的零镜头基准显示,前沿模型和开源模型之间存在巨大差距,将低水平的抓取,变形的物体操纵,接触后物理控制确定为关键瓶颈. 此外,对Robo University-10K进行监督的微调使Robo University-35B-A3B生产,大大改进了零射成功,实现了跨越外部基准和真正的Franka臂的零射任务完成。 通过开放RL准备环境和模式,我们的目标是为在线强化学习打下可扩展的基础。

blocks.en: Despite these advances, our current framework has several limitations. First, the reconstructed simulation scenes remain relatively simplified, and the dynamics of complex objects are not yet faithfully captured. In particular, dynamic interactions with articulated appliances such as opening a microwave door are not well modeled, as intricate physical properties like latch resistance, hinge friction, and contact mechanics are difficult to recover accurately from video alone. Second, in terms of task complexity, RoboUniverse-10K currently focuses on short, atomic manipulation skills rather than extended multi-stage workflows, whereas true embodied intelligence requires solving concrete, long-horizon problems in realistic physical settings. Improving physical fidelity for dynamic interactions and scaling automated environment generation toward long-horizon tasks remain important directions for future work.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,我们目前的框架仍然有一些局限性。 第一,重建后的模拟场景仍然相对简化,复杂物体的动态还没有被忠实地抓住. 特别是,与开微波门等明晰器件的动态相互作用没有很好的模型,因为像锁链阻力,锁链摩擦,接触力学等复杂的物理特性很难单独从视频中准确恢复. 其次,在任务复杂性方面,RoboUniverse-10K目前侧重于短的原子操纵技能,而不是扩展的多阶段工作流程,而真正的内含智能则需要在现实物理环境下解决具体,长的视野问题. 提高动态互动的物理忠诚度,使环境生成自动化,以完成长期任务,仍然是今后工作的重要方向。

blocks.en: 7.3 Quality Assurance: Independent Review and Repair
blocks.zh: 7.3 质量保证:独立审查和维修

blocks.en: An independent QA agent reviews a copy of the builder’s environment. It compares the source demonstration with the simulated run, focusing on what the robot acts on and how the object responds. For a pick-and-place task, for example, the reviewer uses the video and recorded object state to check that the object moves with the gripper after contact and settles on the support after release. It then resets the scene and replays the saved control commands to check that they reproduce the outcome.
blocks.zh: 独立的质量保证代理商审查建筑商的环境。 它将源演示与模拟运行相比较,专注于机器人在什么上的行为以及物体的反应. 例如,对于一个 pick-and-place 任务,审查者使用视频和录制对象状态来检查对象在接触后与抓取器一起移动,并在发布后在支持上结算. 然后它重新播放现场并重播保存的控制命令,以检查它们复制结果.

blocks.en: The reviewer also checks the verifier against the written instruction. It considers both a plausible failure that should be rejected and a different way to achieve the stated goal that should earn credit. When it identifies a defect, the reviewer repairs the scene, controller, or verifier and reruns the case that exposed the problem. It then repeats the reference run and reset replay with the revised verifier and records the evidence and any unresolved issues. Appendix 9.3 gives excerpts from the review prompt.

blocks.en: 8 Benchmark Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 8 基准评价细节

blocks.en: 8.1 Test-Set Construction
blocks.zh: 第8.1条 试验-成套建筑

blocks.en: The 500 tasks in RoboUniverse-Verified are produced by the same Real2Sim construction and QA pipeline as the training tasks ( Section 2.3 ). They are held out as a zero-shot evaluation set and are never used to collect training trajectories. Of these, 200 are single-arm Franka tasks reconstructed from DROID episodes, and 300 are dual-arm AgileX tasks reconstructed from multi-source bimanual teleoperation data. Candidate tasks are drawn from environments that pass automated QA by stratified sampling over embodiments and task families, so that the test set covers all eight task families while preserving the diversity of data sources and scenes as far as possible.
blocks.zh: RoboUniverse-Verifered的500项任务由与培训任务相同的Real2Sim建造和QA管道(第2.3节)生产. 它们是作为零镜头评价的一套,从未用于收集培训轨迹。 其中200项是从DROID事件重建的单臂Franka任务,300项是双臂Agile X任务由多源双源远程操作数据重建. 候选任务来自环境,通过分层采样通过表征和任务家庭通过自动化质量保证,使测试包涵盖所有八个任务家庭,同时尽可能保持数据来源和场景的多样性。

blocks.en: All candidate tasks are manually verified by 10 human experts in embodied AI. With reference to the source video, task instruction, simulation replay, and verifier code, the experts check each task against four criteria: (1) the instruction is clear, unambiguous, and consistent with the task goal in the source video; (2) the scene layout, object geometry, and physical parameters (e.g., mass, friction, and joint limits) are plausible; (3) the reference controller reliably completes the task after scene reset; and (4) the verifier rejects typical failure outcomes while accepting valid alternative solutions, so that it produces no misjudgments. Tasks that fail any check are returned for revision and re-verification, and tasks that cannot be fixed are removed from the candidate pool. All 500 retained tasks pass every check, which ensures that each task is solvable and reliably graded.
blocks.zh: 所有候选任务均由10名人工智能专家进行人工核查。 关于源视频,任务指令,模拟重播,以及验证码,专家们根据四个标准检查每项任务:(1)指令明确,毫不含糊,符合源视频中的任务目标;(2)场景布局,对象几何,物理参数(如质量,摩擦,和联合限值)合理合理;(3)参考控制器在场景重置后可靠地完成任务;(4)核查人员在接受有效替代解决方案的同时拒绝典型的失败结果,从而不产生错误判断. 任何检查失败的任务都会被退回修订和重新核实,无法确定的任务会被从候选人才库中移除. 所有500项保留的任务都通过每一份检查,确保每项任务都能够解决并可靠地分级。

blocks.en: The source data of the single-arm tasks carry 20 manipulation subcategory labels. Because a source label does not always match the capability that a task tests (e.g., a stack_unstack task may require insertion, and a pick_place task may also close a drawer), each task is assigned individually, based on its instruction, to one of nine fine categories: place, reposition, assemble, open_close, actuate, clean, transfer_mix, deform, and composite. These map to the four single-arm families as follows: Pick & Place comprises place and reposition; Assembly & Articulation comprises assemble, open_close, and actuate; Deformable & Material comprises clean, transfer_mix, and deform; and Composite comprises composite. Table 6 shows the resulting composition of each family by source subcategory; 11 of the 20 subcategories are split across families. Since the source data of the dual-arm tasks lack unified subcategory labels, we first use a language model to pre-classify these tasks from their instructions, following the definitions of the four dual-arm task families in Section 2 : tasks whose main difficulty lies in deformable objects or pouring are assigned to Co-Deformable & Transfer ; tasks comprising two or more subgoals of different types with sequential dependencies are assigned to Staged Coordination ; tasks dominated by assembly, insertion, cap twisting, or one arm stabilizing an object while the other manipulates it are assigned to Co-Assembly & Stabilization ; and the remaining transport and handover tasks are assigned to Co-Transport & Handover . These four families correspond to seven fine categories: Co-Transport & Handover comprises cooperative transport and reorientation (36 tasks) and handover and regrasping (57); Co-Assembly & Stabilization comprises cooperative assembly and disassembly (32) and stabilize-and-manipulate (67); Co-Deformable & Transfer comprises coordinated transfer (33) and deformable manipulation (45); and Staged Coordination comprises staged coordination (30). The experts then review and confirm the family of every single-arm and dual-arm task individually, based on the primary manipulation capability that the task assesses.
blocks.zh: 单臂任务的源数据包含20个操纵子类标签. 由于一个源标签并不总是匹配一个任务测试的能力(例如,一个堆栈_unstack任务可能需要插入,一个 pick_place任务也可能关闭一个抽屉),因此根据它的指示,每个任务被单独分配到九个精细类别中的一个:位置,重新定位,组装,打开_close,激活,清洁,转移_混合,变形,和复合. 这四个单臂家庭的地图如下: Pick & Place 包括位置和重新定位; 组装和渲染包括组装、 打开_ 关闭和激活; 可变形和材料包括清洁、 转移_ 混合和变形; 复合材料包括复合材料。 表6按来源子类别列出了每个家庭的构成情况;20个子类别中,有11个家庭被划分。 由于双臂任务的源数据缺乏统一的子类标签,我们首先使用一种语言模型从指令中对这些任务进行预先分类,遵循第2节中四个双臂任务家族的定义:主要困难在于变形对象或倾注的任务被分配到共同变形和转移中;由两个或两个以上不同类型具有相继依存关系子目标的任务被分配到分阶段协调中;任务以组装,插入,顶盖扭矩,或一个臂稳定一个对象为主,而另一个操纵则被分配到共同大会和稳定中;其余的运输和移交任务被分配到共同运输和转移中. 这四个家庭对应了七个精细的类别: 共同运输和移交包括合作运输和调整方向(36项任务)以及移交和重新放牧(57项);共同大会和稳定包括合作组装和拆卸(32项)以及稳定和管理(67项);共同可变和转让包括协调转让(33项)和变形操纵(45项);分阶段协调包括分阶段协调(30项)。 然后,专家们根据任务评估的主要操纵能力,逐一审查和确认每一项单臂和双臂任务。

blocks.en: Table 6 : Composition of the single-arm task families by source subcategory. Counts are numbers of test tasks. Subcategories marked with † are split across families because each task is assigned individually according to its instruction.

Table 7 summarizes basic statistics of the test set. Task instructions have a median length of about 40 English words. They specify the target objects, the desired final state, and completion conditions such as releasing the object and letting it come to rest, but do not prescribe how the robot should move. The verifier of each task consists of several named binary conditions (e.g., lid_open , keychain_outside_bag , and grippers_released ), each of which corresponds to a physical measurement and its threshold; a task is judged successful only when all conditions are satisfied simultaneously. These conditions typically cover three aspects: effective interaction with the target object, the target final state, and coming to rest after release.
blocks.zh: 表7汇总了测试集的基本统计数据。 任务指令的中位长度约为40个英文单词. 它们指定了目标对象,理想的最终状态,以及完成条件,如释放对象并让它休息,但没有规定机器人应该如何移动. 每项任务的验证器由几个命名的二进制条件(例如:盖_打开,键链_外侧_bag,和抓取器_释放)组成,每个条件对应物理测量及其阈值;只有在同时满足所有条件时,才判断任务成功. 这些条件通常包括三个方面:与目标对象的有效互动,目标最终状态,释放后开始休息.
